annotations.title: High-Density Technical Document & RFC Executive Summarizer

description: Condenses long technical specifications, RFCs, research papers, or meeting transcripts into high-density executive bullet points preserving exact figures and decisions. Use when producing a human-readable executive summary of a single provided document; for researching a topic across the live web with Google Search citations, use synthesize_web_intelligence_brief instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'text' ('summary_format' defaults to 'executive_bullets'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (100 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

summary_format.description: Output presentation structure; defaults to 'executive_bullets' when omitted.

text.description: Full document text, RFC, or transcript to summarize.

name: summarize_technical_document

compression_achieved.description: True when output length is <25% of input length.
